id.description: Unique identifier for the logical object that instance of this type represents.

name.description: The name of the component. Optional field for informational purposes only.

dataSpec.description:
The data settings for this component.

@uiSdlDesignerCustomRenderer(rendererType='')

disableDataRequestOnFirstRender.description: Component level boolean to disable a data fetch on first render.

triggersRegistered.description: Whether the effect triggers and epics have been registered

wrapWithMetadataId.description: Whether to wrap the component with a div which has a class name of its metdata id. Useful for targeting with css.

formFieldValues.description:
A mapping of field name to value.

NOTE: the value of this field has to be a JSON object. JSON arrays may pass validation but should not be used.

dataRecord.description: The field which contains the data backing the form.

internalDataSpec.description: The data spec that will hold the the internal datasources for UiSdlFilterPanel.

internalData.description: Stores the internal data defined in UiSdlFilterPanelInternalDataSpec.

filterButtonText.description: The text to display on the primary button in the filter panel.

clearButtonText.description: The text to display on the secondary button in the filter panel.

deleteSavedSearchesError.description: Whether or not there was an error when trying to delete a saved search.

deletedSavedSearches.description: A list of saved searches that have been deleted from the filter panel.

renamedSavedSearches.description: A mapping from saved search id to its new name.

cancelSaveSearchText.description: Text for the `Cancel` button on the save search subpanel.

saveSearchSubtitle.description: Text for the save search subtitle.

saveSearchTitle.description: Text for the save search title.

renameSearchPanelSubtitle.description: Text for the rename search subpanel's subtitle.

renameSearchPanelTitle.description: Text for the rename search subpanel's title.

saveSearchFieldLabel.description: Text for the save search field label.

advancedFieldLabel.description: Text for the advanced field label.

loadSearchPanelSubtitle.description: Text for the load save search panel subtitle.

loadSearchPanelTitle.description: Text for the load save search panel title.

cancelLoadSearchButtonText.description: Text for the load save search panel's cancel button.

saveAsPrivateToggleText.description: Text for the save as private toggle button.

settingsMenu.description: Dropdown items in a settings menu.

title:
A type which represents a filter panel, which may be composed of 1-N form fields.
Generally used to create a filtered configuration to pass to a {@link UiSdlFilterable} component.
name: UiSdlFilterPanel
